snippet.title: Bearplane Gameplay - Early Prototype (2020)
snippet.description:
I started making this game after being inspired by a literal bear named Wotjek who served in the Polish Army during WW2. He was even promoted to Corporal... That ACTUALLY happened!

I'm 15ish hours into the project... Let me know if you'd like to see a polished (ha) version of this to play. I'll be sure to fix that gross audio and background noise :D. Thanks!

Music: The Ink Spots - It's All Over But The Crying
(one of my faves!)

Video on Wotjek: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x-b5G4QUOzs
